html:
A nomadic people of the upper Liao River, in what is now Inner Mongolia and northeast China, who spoke a language related to Mongolian. The map shows them in 900, just before they built an empire.

For centuries the Khitans herded horses, cattle and sheep between the Chinese and Turkic worlds, paying tribute to whichever was stronger. When the Uyghur Khaganate fell in 840 and the Tang collapsed in 907, they rose. Yelü Abaoji united the tribes and in 916 declared himself emperor of what became the Liao dynasty. He destroyed Balhae in 926, and his heirs took a strip of north China that included Beijing.

In 1005 the Treaty of Chanyuan made the Song pay them silver and silk every year. The Khitans created scripts for their language and ruled Chinese and nomads under separate laws. Their name reached Europe and Russia as Cathay and Kitai, words for China. After the Jurchen overthrew the Liao in 1125, a branch went west and founded the Qara Khitai.
sum: A nomadic people of the upper Liao River, in what is now Inner Mongolia and northeast China, who spoke a language related to Mongolian. The map shows them in 900, just before they built an empire.
